Rumparooz Newborn Cloth Diaper Cover

The Rumparooz Newborn Cloth Diaper Cover is a premium reusable cloth diaper cover designed specifically for newborn babies. With a waterproof outer shell, adjustable fit, and trim, flexible design, this cover fits babies from 4 to 15 lbs and can be used over newborn prefolds, flats, fitted diapers, and inserts for a customizable newborn cloth diapering system. Building on two decades of trusted innovation, Rumparooz diaper covers continue Kanga Care’s legacy of quality, comfort, and dependable everyday performance.

Key Cover Features

  • 3 adjustable sizes to fit approximately 4 to 15 lbs
  • Waterproof TPU shell helps contain moisture while remaining silky soft and flexible
  • Designed specifically for newborns with a trim, comfortable fit
  • Trim fit works well over newborn prefolds, flats, fitted diapers, and other absorbent options
  • Snap closure allows for an adjustable and secure fit
  • Gentle leg, back & tummy elastic helps provide reliable containment
  • Side-wall leg gussets help contain messes and provide custom fit over absorbency
  • Wipeable shell allows for multiple uses between washes when not soiled

Designed for Newborn Cloth Diapering Systems

The Rumparooz Newborn Cloth Diaper Cover is designed for families who want the flexibility to build their own absorbency system during the early weeks of cloth diapering. Pair it with your preferred newborn prefolds, flats, fitted diapers, doublers, or boosters to create the level of absorbency your baby needs throughout the day and night.

This makes diaper covers a popular option for parents who want a simple, versatile, and economical newborn cloth diapering routine. By separating the waterproof shell from the absorbent diaper layers, you can often reuse the cover multiple times before washing, as long as it is not soiled.

Waterproof and Flexible TPU Shell

The Rumparooz newborn cover features a soft waterproof bio-TPU shell created using an eco-conscious heat bonding process that avoids harsh chemical adhesives. This advanced material provides reliable waterproof protection while offering a more environmentally conscious alternative to traditional PUL laminates. The fabric is smooth, lightweight, and flexible, creating reliable protection without adding unnecessary bulk.

A Great Choice for Newborn Prefolds, Flats, and Fitted Diapers

Reusable cloth diaper covers are a favorite among families who prefer a highly customizable system and want to use natural fiber absorbency options from the very beginning. The Rumparooz Newborn Cloth Diaper Cover is a great choice for parents looking for a dependable newborn cloth diaper cover for prefolds, flats, or fitted diapers with an adjustable fit and long-lasting value.

Kanga Care Wet Bag

The Kanga Care Wet Bag is a roomy, waterproof storage solution designed to make cloth diapering, travel, and everyday adventures easier. With its unique half-moon shape, this reusable wet bag comfortably holds approximately 15–18 diapers and inserts while remaining compact and easy to carry.

The thoughtful 3D design creates extra interior space, while the sturdy zipper and front-opening design allow the top to fold over like a small lid for easy access. A convenient detachable hanging strap with heavy-duty snap allows you to clip the bag to a stroller, changing table, doorknob, or hook wherever you need it.

Perfect for cloth diapers, wet clothing, swimwear, travel laundry, yoga, the gym, youth sports, or everyday messes, the Kanga Care Wet Bag is a versatile reusable storage solution for busy families.

Eco-Conscious Waterproof Fabric

Kanga Care Wet Bags are made using a compostable bio-TPU laminated polyester fabric. This material is created using a solvent-free thermoplastic polyurethane heat bonding process that avoids harsh chemical adhesives. The result is a soft, flexible, waterproof fabric designed to safely contain moisture while offering a more environmentally conscious alternative to traditional PUL laminates.

Key Features of the Kanga Care Wet Bag

  • Holds approximately 15–18 diapers and inserts
  • Half-moon shape provides added storage volume
  • Waterproof bio-TPU laminated fabric helps contain moisture
  • Detachable hanging strap with heavy-duty snap for easy attachment
  • Barrier Seam Sealing helps prevent leaks through stitched areas
  • No gluing or ironing used to seal seams
  • Seams are physically sealed away from moisture
  • Heavy-duty YKK zipper designed for durability and easy grabbing

products.body_html:
Kanga Care Changing Pad

The Kanga Care Changing Pad is a soft, waterproof sheet saver designed to protect changing tables, diaper stations, and surfaces during diaper changes. With a multi-functional three-layer design, which includes a gentle stay-dry and hypoallergenic fabric on top, a hidden absorbent core, and waterproof backing, this reusable changing pad helps contain messes while keeping babies comfortable. It can also be flipped over and used as a slightly wipeable surface with a no-slip bottom layer. 

Its versatile size makes it perfect for use at home on changing tables, dressers, beds, or floors, and it also works well as a portable changing mat for diaper bags and travel. The flexible design folds easily for compact storage when you're on the go.

Reusable changing pads are a practical solution for everyday diaper changes, helping protect surfaces while reducing the need for disposable liners.

Soft Waterproof Protection

The Kanga Care Changing Pads are 3-layers, featuring a stay-dry microchamois fabric top layer, combined with a hidden absorbent core and a waterproof bio-TPU backing designed to protect surfaces from moisture and messes. The absorbent core will help soak up small accidents while the waterproof layer helps protect any surface and the soft top layer provides comfort for baby. 

Key Features of the Kanga Care Changing Pad

  • Soft fabric top layer for baby comfort
  • Waterproof bio-TPU backing protects changing surfaces
  • Absorbent core for small accidents
  • Versatile sheet saver design for changing tables, beds, or floors
  • Portable and lightweight for diaper bags and travel
  • Reusable and machine washable for easy cleanup
  • Helps protect mattresses and furniture during diaper changes

A Convenient Sheet Saver for Everyday Changes

The Kanga Care Changing Pad is designed to make diaper changes easier while protecting surfaces from unexpected messes. Its lightweight, flexible design makes it easy to use at home or bring along for travel, giving parents a dependable reusable changing surface wherever they go.

products.body_html:
Lil Joey Newborn & Preemie AIO Cloth Diaper | 2 pk | Archive Release

The Lil Joey Newborn & Preemie AIO Cloth Diaper is an all-in-one newborn cloth diaper designed for babies approximately 4–12 lbs, including many preemies and newborns. Featuring 4 layers of sewn-in absorbency, an umbilical cord snap-down, and Kanga Care's patented Double Inner Gusset technology, Lil Joey provides a trim fit with dependable leak and blowout protection during the earliest weeks of cloth diapering.

With no inserts to stuff, Lil Joey makes diaper changes quick, simple, and convenient for new parents while delivering the comfort, quality, and performance families have trusted for nearly 20 years.

Laundry Tip:
Flip Lil Joey inside out and snap the wings backwards before washing. This helps keep the diaper open during the wash cycle for better cleaning and faster drying.

6r Soaker Insert Set | Cotton Waffle – 12 Layer Overnight Absorbency

The Kanga Care 6r Soaker Cotton Waffle Insert Set is designed for families who need maximum absorbency and reliable overnight performance. This premium insert set is made from structured cotton waffle fabric that delivers excellent absorbency while maintaining durability and performance over time, providing 12 total absorbent layers across the two-piece system.

Cotton waffle fabric is highly absorbent due to its raised, pocketed waffle weave structure, which creates increased surface area to capture and distribute moisture more effectively. These small pockets help pull liquid away from the surface and spread it evenly throughout the fabric, reducing pooling and improving overall performance. This structure allows cotton waffle to absorb efficiently while maintaining high capacity and stability under pressure, making it an ideal choice for overnight diapering and heavy wetters.

Each layer is constructed with a dense 260 GSM fabric, resulting in an impressive 3,120 GSM total absorbency per 6r Soaker set. This makes cotton waffle one of the most powerful and structured absorbency options available for cloth diapering.

12 Layer Absorbency System

  • Newborn Insert: 6 layers of cotton waffle fabric
  • One Size Insert: 6 layers of cotton waffle fabric
  • Total: 12 layers and 3,120 GSM absorbency

Why Choose Cotton Waffle?

  • High absorbency capacity for overnight and extended wear
  • Waffle texture increases surface area for improved liquid distribution
  • Structured fabric performance helps reduce pooling and compression leaks
  • Durable cotton fibers maintain performance wash after wash

Adjustable & Customizable Absorbency

  • Two-piece system allows you to adjust absorbency levels
  • Use newborn insert alone for lighter absorbency
  • Snap both inserts together for full 12-layer overnight performance
  • Customize positioning for boys (front wetters) and girls (middle wetters)

Multiply Your Absorbency Options

Multiple 6r Soaker sets can be layered to create a wide range of absorbency combinations for different needs:

  • Stack inserts for overnight and heavy wetters

  • Combine with other materials for custom layering systems

Mix & Match for Maximum Performance

All 6r Soaker inserts are interchangeable, allowing you to combine materials for optimal performance.

  • Microfiber provides fast absorption
  • Bamboo offers soft, high-capacity absorbency
  • Cotton waffle provides structured, even moisture distribution
  • Hemp delivers dense, long-lasting moisture storage

Pro Tip: Pair a Microfiber insert on top of a cotton waffle insert to create a powerful two-stage system — fast absorption on top with deep, evenly distributed storage underneath.

Designed for Versatility

The 6r Soaker Cotton Waffle Insert Set was designed to complement the Rumparooz One Size Pocket Cloth Diaper, but its flexible sizing and customizable absorbency make it compatible with most pocket diapers.

From newborn through toddlerhood, this insert set adapts to your baby’s changing absorbency needs.

products.title: Kanga Care Silicone & Wood Paci Clip - Rainbow
products.body_html:
Keep that pacifier off the ground! Don’t let that teething ring tumble away!

Meet Rainbow Paci Clips - a combination of fun colors for everyone. The Kanga Care Pacifier Clip is a must have for every parent’s diaper bag! Available in 6 styles, this pacifier clip universally attaches to any pacifier, or teething ring, preventing your little one from dropping it on the ground or out of reach. Easily attach to baby’s clothing with the smooth and modern design.

Details
  • Beads are permanently attached to the clip.
  • Silicone beads are made of premium quality 100% medical grade silicone, 100% non toxic, odorless, BPA free, and lead free.
  • Wooden beads are natural and eco friendly.
  • Pacifier Clip measures 9.5" from tip of clip to end of loop
Use & Safety
  • Do not use without full supervision.
  • Never attach to ribbons, cords, laces or loose parts of clothing which could become a choking hazard.
  • Kanga Care recommends only attaching the clip to clothing garments.
  • Inspect clip and silicone beads before every use and discard if damaged or beads come loose.
  • 3 ventilation holes compliant to stringent EU regulations.
  • Lead free and nickel free stainless-steel metal clip.
  • Plastic inserts secure grip while preventing damage to clothing.
Care
  • Wipe-clean only; do not sterilize or submerge in water.
  • If wood finish dulls over time, lightly sand the surface to smooth with a fine-tooth sandpaper, then apply a 50/50 mixture of beeswax and food grade oil. Give treatment time to soak in, then wipe away any excess oil.
How to Attach
  • Pass the loop through a hole in the pacifier or the ring of a toy.
  • Put the wooden button/clip through the loop.
  • Pull the full length of the Paci Clip and silicone beads through the loop.
  • Tighten the slip knot down to secure the Paci Clip onto the pacifier or toy.
  • Reverse the Paci Clip through the loop to undo and remove.

Mighty Bubbles Laundry Treatment

Restore Absorbency. Remove Buildup. Reset Your Cloth Diapers.

Mighty Bubbles is an advanced laundry treatment designed to deep clean cloth diapers and performance fabrics when regular detergent is no longer enough. Over time, detergent residue, hard water minerals, and organic buildup can reduce absorbency and cause lingering odor. Mighty Bubbles penetrates deep into fabric fibers to break down buildup, lift stubborn residue, and restore fabrics to peak performance.

Why Cloth Diaper Families Trust Mighty Bubbles

  • Breaks down detergent and mineral buildup
  • Restores absorbency in cloth diapers and inserts
  • Eliminates deep-set odors
  • Safe for PUL, elastics, and specialty diaper fabrics
  • Dissolves completely with no residue left behind
  • Compatible with top-loading and front-loading washers
  • H•E compliant
  • Detergent Quality Quick Score 5/5 Stars

How to Use

Add one Mighty Bubbles pac directly into the washer drum and run a hot wash cycle. No measuring, no mess, no guesswork. For severe buildup, repeat as needed.

Ideal For

  • Cloth diapers and absorbent inserts
  • Towels and microfiber
  • Athletic wear and performance fabrics
  • Linens and everyday laundry needing a deep reset

What’s Included

Value Pouch includes 20 pre-measured pacs for long-term laundry maintenance and routine performance resets.

Clean Standards You Can Trust

  • Made in the U.S.A.
  • Vegan
  • Not tested on animals
  • Phosphate free
  • No ammonia
  • No alcohol or ethers
  • pH neutral

Mighty Bubbles is the deep clean cloth diapers need to perform at their best. Whether you are restoring absorbency, troubleshooting leaks, or maintaining a healthy wash routine, this powerful laundry treatment keeps your fabrics functioning like new.

products.title: Snappi - Neutral 3 pk :: Toddler
products.body_html:
Introducing Snappi Neutral 3 pack for toddlers - cloth diaper fasteners in traditional gender neutral colors. Snappies replace Diaper Pins for our Prefolds & Flats Diapering Options.

What is a Snappi?

Where ever you would use a diaper safety pin, use a Snappi instead and Snappi away your diaper pinning blues! This Snappi fastener is the perfect solution to make diaper changes more efficient. With its secure grip and stretchy design, this fastener won't let that cloth rear show the slightest hint of sagging – so you can keep little ones snug and comfy! Goodbye nappy pins, hello Snappi!

How do I use a Snappi Cloth Diaper Fastener?

Using a Snappi is a simple and effective way to secure cloth diapers without the need for pins. The Snappi is designed with T-shaped grips and stretchable hooks to hold the diaper fabric in place. Here's a step-by-step guide on how to use a Snappi diaper fastener:

  1. Diaper the Baby: Place your diaper of choice onto baby
  2. Position the Snappi: Place the center of the Snappi on the front of the diaper, just below the waistband with the logo facing up. The Snappi should resemble a "T" shape.
  3. Hook the Left Side: With your right hand, place the left hook into the diaper fabric on the left front hip area of the diaper. Stretch the Snappi and pull it horizontally across the diaper, holding the fabric securely in place. Keep the tension on the Snappi firm but not too tight.
  4. Hook the Right Side: When you right the front right hip area of the diaper, place the teeth of the right hook in the diaper fabric.
  5. Hook the Bottom: Once the right and left sides are hold the wings of the diaper closed  is it time to secure the Snappi. Stretch the bottom grip of the Snappi and pull it straight down, hooking it onto the center of the diaper between the legs. The Snappi should now form a "Y" shape. This will help prevent the diaper from sagging and ensure a snug fit.
  6. Check the Fit: Once the Snappi is attached, check the fit of the diaper to make sure it's snug but not too tight. You should be able to fit one finger between the diaper and your baby's skin at the waist and legs.
  7. Add a Kanga Care Diaper Cover: If you're using a Snappi with a prefold or flat diaper, you will want to put a waterproof diaper cover over the cloth diaper to prevent leaks.

That's it! Using a Snappi is an excellent way to secure cloth diapers quickly and efficiently, without the need for pins, making diaper changes easier for you and your baby.

products.title: Lil Joey All In One Cloth Diaper (2 pk) - Sherbert
products.body_html:
Introducing Sherbert - A classic, simple, pink Lil Joey cloth diaper. The Lil Joey is a newborn diaper designed to fit from approximately 4-12lbs. Kanga Care brand cloth diapers are the ORIGINAL and ONLY cloth diapers uniquely designed with the patented leak protection technology of dual inner gussets. The inside of each diaper is designed with 2 gentle inner gussets, a double barrier that channels each leg. There is no chance of escape for even the messiest of messes! The Lil Joey takes special care with a snap down front for sensitive cord care during those first precious days.

The Lil Joey is the simplest of diaper systems on the market for a newborn baby. The internal soaker is 4 layers of thirsty microfiber that have been permanently sewn into the core of the diaper, no stuffing required. The Lil Joey is waterproof and requires no cover. Kanga Care uses a water resistant polyester TPU which a is solvent-free polyester fabric that has been laminated with a thermoplastic polyurethane using a heat bonding process, not chemicals. This process is low in toxicity and is better for the natural environment then traditional PUL. One of the most important decisions new parents face, just got easier!

Additional Information

To Use:

  • Before first use, wash diapers once.
  • If cord stump is still present, snap down the cord care feature.
  • After cord stump has healed, cord snap feature may be un-snapped. Chose whichever snap settings fits your newborn the best.
  • Fasten diaper to baby!
Wash & Care Instructions

The number one thing to remember when caring for your diapers is they are just another load! There is no magical solution that you should need and no crazy tricks.

Washing Instructions

  • 1 Cold rinse
  • 2 Hot wash: add the recommended amount of detergent for the appropriate load size.
  • 3 Cool rinse
  • 4 Tumble dry low or lay flat to dry in indirect sunlight.

Detergent Recommendations

Click here for Kanga Care's list of recommended detergents that have undergone testing and fulfill the necessary requirements for effectively cleaning human waste.

Please do not use laundry additives such as bleach, Oxiclean, Borax or Bac-out to wash your Kanga Care products, learn more about how this can negatively effect your cloth diapers and accessories.

If you have questions about our washing instructions, please ask! We are happy to help!

products.title: Kanga Care Wet Bag - Whimsical
products.body_html:
Kanga Care Wet Bag Whimsical is the perfect way to stay organized and stylish! 

Kanga Care Wet Bags are a standard size wet bag, except instead of being flat (like an envelope), they are HALF MOON shaped to allow more volume. This design is EXCLUSIVE to Kanga Care. This wet bag will hold up to 12 to 15 diapers and inserts. The Kanga Care Wet Bags have color matching, heavy duty zippers that are easy to grab. The zipper is placed on the front so the top of the bag functions as a lid. There is a strap on top that can be opened by an industrial strength snap so that the bag can be attached to a stroller handle, door knob, or other ideal hanging place. To clean, machine wash with your diapers or other soiled items. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Visit www.kangacare.com for further information. Kanga Care uses a water resistant polyester TPU which is solvent-free polyester fabric that has been laminated with a thermoplastic polyurethane using a heat bonding process, not chemicals. This process is low in toxicity and is better for the natural environment then traditional PUL.

Key Features of the Kanga Care Wet Bag:

  • Holds up to 15 diapers and 15 inserts
  • Barrier Seam Sealing
  • No "gluing" nor "ironing" to seal seams.
  • Seams are physically sealed away from moisture!
  • Heavy duty, easy to grab & zip!
  • Color matching YKK Zippers

The Rumparooz One Size Cloth Diaper Cover is designed to grow with your baby, with 4 adjustable rise settings; newborn, small, medium and large. The Lil Joey is a newborn diaper designed to fit from approximately 4-12lbs. Kanga Care brand cloth diapers are the ORIGINAL and ONLY cloth diapers uniquely designed with the patented leak protection technology of dual inner gussets. The inside of each diaper is designed with 2 gentle inner gussets, a double barrier that channels each leg. There is no chance of escape for even the messiest of messes! The Lil Joey takes special care with a snap down front for sensitive cord care during those first precious days.

This process is low in toxicity and is better for the natural environment then traditional PUL. One of the most important decisions new parents face, just got easier!

products.title: Rumparooz One Size Cloth Diaper Covers - Aspenglow
products.body_html:
Aspenglow | Rumparooz One Size Cloth Diaper Cover

Soft, serene, and quietly beautiful, Aspenglow reflects a winter forest of aspen trees warmed by subtle earthy tones. Timeless and gentle for everyday adventures.

One Size Cover = 4 Sizes in One!

The Rumparooz One Size Cloth Diaper Cover is a versatile option for your growing baby! It has 4 adjustable rise settings (for newborn, small, medium, and large sizes) and fits little ones weighing 6 to 40+ pounds. You can also use it over most fitted or prefold diapers. Best of all, it's machine washable - just toss it in the laundry when it needs a refresh.

Kanga Care uses fancy, eco-friendly and compostable bio-TPU in a delicate heat bonding process, so no harsh chemicals are involved. A eco-conscious upgrade to traditional PUL.

Additional Information

To Use:

  • Before first use, wash diapers once.
  • Snap diaper rise to proper size setting.
  • Fasten cover to baby over a flat, pre-fold or fitted diaper.
Wash & Care Instructions

The number one thing to remember when caring for your diapers is they are just another load! There is no magical solution that you should need and no crazy tricks.

Washing Instructions

  • 1 Cold rinse
  • 2 Hot wash: add the recommended amount of detergent for the appropriate load size.
  • 3 Cool rinse
  • 4 Tumble dry low or lay flat to dry in indirect sunlight.

Detergent Recommendations

Click here for Kanga Care's list of recommended detergents that have undergone testing and fulfill the necessary requirements for effectively cleaning human waste.

Please do not use laundry additives such as bleach, Oxiclean, Borax or Bac-out to wash your Kanga Care products, learn more about how this can negatively effect your cloth diapers and accessories.

If you have questions about our washing instructions, please ask! We are happy to help!

products.title: SprayMate Cloth Diaper Sprayer Bundle | Aquaus 360 Faucet Hook-Up
products.body_html:
SprayMate Cloth Diaper Sprayer Bundle (Faucet Hook-Up) 

Complete toilet-side cloth diaper sprayer system for cloth diapers.

The RinseWorks Aquaus 360 + SprayMate Bundle combines a high-pressure faucet hook-up diaper sprayer with a hands-free splatter shield system. Designed for cloth diapering families, this bundle makes spraying solids simple, hygienic, and mess-free.

Instead of rinsing directly into toilet water, the SprayMate shield controls splash-back and helps reduce airborne spray. The Aquaus 360 sprayer delivers adjustable pressure for thorough cleaning while protecting your bathroom from overspray.

Please note: This item ships directly from the manufacturer and is not eligible for Kanga Care’s sitewide free shipping promotions.

New to cloth diapering? See our complete cloth diaper sprayer guide.

What’s Included

  • SprayMate Splatter Shield
  • Drip Pan
  • 6 Strong Spring Clips
  • Aquaus 360 High-Pressure Diaper Sprayer (Faucet Hook-up)

Why Use a Cloth Diaper Sprayer Shield?

Rinsing cloth diapers directly in toilet water can cause splash-back and airborne droplets. The SprayMate’s sloped wall design directs water downward toward a narrow drain slot positioned just above toilet water level. This helps:

  • Reduce splatter and bathroom mess
  • Minimize airborne spray during rinsing
  • Control high-pressure water rebound
  • Allow hands-free clipping and spraying

The result is a cleaner, more controlled diaper spraying experience.

How the SprayMate System Works

Soiled diapers are clipped inside the SprayMate using the included spring clips. The Aquaus 360 sprayer connects to your faucet and delivers adjustable spray pressure.

As water hits the sloped interior walls, it is directed downward into the drain slot rather than bouncing upward. Dirty water drains gently into the toilet instead of splashing back into the air.

The included drip pan allows the unit to sit on the floor for drip-drying before washing.

Faucet Compatibility & Installation

The Aquaus 360 faucet hook-up is designed to work with most standard sink faucets using the included diverter. Installation typically takes just a few minutes and does not require permanent plumbing changes.

If your faucet has a removable aerator, you can usually install the sprayer quickly and switch between normal faucet use and spray mode with the turn of the diverter.

Key Features

  • Designed specifically for cloth diaper rinsing
  • Compatible with high-pressure bidet or diaper sprayers
  • Hands-free clipping system
  • Dual-use legs sit on toilet rim or floor
  • Drip pan prevents floor drips
  • Slim 8.5” profile for compact storage
  • Comfortable standing height
  • Can double as a small lined trash container

Specifications

  • Dimensions: 8.5” W x 19” H x 16.5” L
  • Weight: 3 lbs
  • Includes USA & International Patents and Patents Pending

Who This Is For

This diaper sprayer bundle is ideal for:

  • Cloth diapering families starting solids
  • Parents who want a cleaner toilet spraying setup
  • Homes without a built-in bidet
  • Anyone needing to rinse potty seat bowls, bedpans, undergarments, bibs, or heavily soiled laundry

Shipping Information

  • Ships directly from the manufacturer
  • Does not qualify for free shipping promotions
  • International and non-contiguous US rates may be adjusted if carrier calculations differ at checkout. We will contact you before any additional billing.

Bring festive flair to diaper time with Glaskugeln, a whimsical print that celebrates the beauty of vintage holiday ornaments. Hand-painted watercolor artistry dances across soft fabric in a palette of icy blues, jewel-toned teals, and glimmering gold accents. It's the perfect blend of old-world charm and contemporary style - proof that even the most practical baby gear can spark a little seasonal magic.

One Size Cover = 4 Sizes in One!

The Rumparooz One Size Cloth Diaper Cover is a versatile option for your growing baby! It has 4 adjustable rise settings (for newborn, small, medium, and large sizes) and fits little ones weighing 6 to 40+ pounds. You can also use it over most fitted or prefold diapers. Best of all, it's machine washable - just toss it in the laundry when it needs a refresh.

Kanga Care uses fancy, eco-friendly and compostable bio-TPU in a delicate heat bonding process, so no harsh chemicals are involved. A eco-conscious upgrade to traditional PUL.

Additional Information

To Use:

  • Before first use, wash diapers once.
  • Snap diaper rise to proper size setting.
  • Fasten cover to baby over a flat, pre-fold or fitted diaper.
Wash & Care Instructions

The number one thing to remember when caring for your diapers is they are just another load! There is no magical solution that you should need and no crazy tricks.

Washing Instructions

  • 1 Cold rinse
  • 2 Hot wash: add the recommended amount of detergent for the appropriate load size.
  • 3 Cool rinse
  • 4 Tumble dry low or lay flat to dry in indirect sunlight.

Detergent Recommendations

Click here for Kanga Care's list of recommended detergents that have undergone testing and fulfill the necessary requirements for effectively cleaning human waste.

Please do not use laundry additives such as bleach, Oxiclean, Borax or Bac-out to wash your Kanga Care products, learn more about how this can negatively effect your cloth diapers and accessories.

If you have questions about our washing instructions, please ask! We are happy to help!

These diapers will shrink approximately 5–10% after prepping (4+ wash/dry cycles recommended) and are sized specifically for baby’s weight range. Our prefolds are available in 4 sizes to ensure a snug, reliable fit at every stage of your baby’s growth.

To achieve full absorbency, wash and dry 4–5 times before first use. This helps strip the natural cotton oils and activates the fluffy, thirsty texture that makes these prefolds so effective. This is also called "quilting".

  • 2 Wash hot: add the recommended amount of detergent for the appropriate load size.

  • 4 Tumble dry low or line dry.

products.title: Lil Learnerz 2.0 Training Pants & Swim Diapers - Clover
products.body_html:
Lil Learnerz 2.0 – Potty Training Just Got an Upgrade!

Say hello to the Lil Learnerz 2.0! Our next generation of potty training pants designed to help your toddler make the big leap from diapers to big kid undies with confidence! These thoughtfully designed training pants offer a perfect balance of independence, comfort, and protection as your little one tackles this important milestone.

AWJ INTERRIOR

Now featuring a Athletic Wicking Jersey (AWJ) interior, Lil Learnerz 2.0 keeps things cool, breathable, and silky-smooth. This fabric is made with enhanced airflow while helping your little learner feel comfortable and confident all day long.

POCKET STYLE TRAINER

Lil Learnerz 2.0 now features a STUFFABLE POCKET, which allows you increase the absorbency of the trainer if your little one needs a little added help for naps, night time or in the beginning stages of potty training. Otherwise, the Lil Learners are pre-built with a dual-layer microfiber core, for absorbing accidents, and a waterproof outer layer to keep clothing and car seats protected.

SNAP SIDE RELEASE

Designed for easy ups and downs, Lil Learnerz 2.0 look and feel just like real underwear with more generous sizing and side-snapping release panels in ALL SIZES - for quick changes. Perfect for early learners who still need a little extra help.

MORE GENEROUS SIZING

Available in sizes XS to XXL (15 lbs - 75+ lbs), Lil Learnerz 2.0 are the perfect potty training partner for every stage of your child’s journey.

products.body_html:
Get ready to hoot and holler with Rumparooz One Size Cloth Diaper Covers in the playful Hoot print! Featuring adorable owls nestled in trees with earthy fall colors, this cloth diaper cover is not only cute, but also practical and eco-friendly. Keep your little one dry and stylish with Hoot!

You can even use it over most fitted or prefold diapers. Plus, it's easy to clean - simply toss it in the laundry for a quick refresh.

Kanga Care uses eco-friendly bio-TPU in a gentle heat bonding process, making it an eco-conscious upgrade from traditional PUL.

The Rumparooz One Size Diaper Covers have 4 adjustable rise settings that are designed to fit your baby from birth to potty training with 1 cover. Weight range of cover stars at 6 lbs and will fit up to 40+ lbs.

Additional Information

To Use:

  • Before first use, wash diapers once.
  • Snap diaper rise to proper size setting.
  • Fasten cover to baby over a flat, pre-fold or fitted diaper.
Wash & Care Instructions

The number one thing to remember when caring for your diapers is they are just another load! There is no magical solution that you should need and no crazy tricks.

Washing Instructions

  • 1 Cold rinse
  • 2 Hot wash: add the recommended amount of detergent for the appropriate load size.
  • 3 Cool rinse
  • 4 Tumble dry low or lay flat to dry in indirect sunlight.

Detergent Recommendations

Click here for Kanga Care's list of recommended detergents that have undergone testing and fulfill the necessary requirements for effectively cleaning human waste.

Please do not use laundry additives such as bleach, Oxiclean, Borax or Bac-out to wash your Kanga Care products, learn more about how this can negatively effect your cloth diapers and accessories.

If you have questions about our washing instructions, please ask! We are happy to help!

  • Snap diaper rise to proper size setting.

Wash & Care Instructions

The number one thing to remember when caring for your diapers is they are just another load! There is no magical solution that you should need and no crazy tricks.

Washing Instructions

  • 1 Cold rinse
  • 2 Hot wash: add the recommended amount of detergent for the appropriate load size.
  • 3 Cool rinse
  • 4 Tumble dry low or lay flat to dry in indirect sunlight.

Detergent Recommendations

Click here for Kanga Care's list of recommended detergents that have undergone testing and fulfill the necessary requirements for effectively cleaning human waste.

Please do not use laundry additives such as bleach, Oxiclean, Borax or Bac-out to wash your Kanga Care products, learn more about how this can negatively effect your cloth diapers and accessories.

If you have questions about our washing instructions, please ask! We are happy to help!

products.title: Rumparooz One Size Cloth Diaper Covers - Thistle Mauve
products.body_html:
Thistle - Soft as a Wild Bloom - Like the first blush of dawn over a desert horizon, "Thistle" is a muted mauve with a touch of warmth, bringing nature’s grace to every moment.  

The beloved Rumparooz One Size Cloth Diaper Cover grows and changes with your little one! With 4 adjustable rise settings (newborn, small, medium, and large), this cover is ideal for infants weighing 6 pounds and up to 40+ pounds. Plus, it's roomy enough to easily fit over most fitted or prefold diapers. No need to worry, you can use it multiple times before washing - simply toss it in the laundry when it needs some TLC. Kanga Care uses bio-TPU in all of its waterproof products, making it incredibly eco-friendly, compostable, high quality and reliable without any harsh chemicals. TPU, unlike PUL, uses a heat bonding process that's kind to the environment. 

One Size Cover = 4 Sizes in One!

The Rumparooz One Size Diaper Covers have 4 adjustable rise settings that are designed to fit your baby from birth to potty training with 1 cover. Weight range of cover stars at 6 lbs and will fit up to 40+ lbs.

Additional Information

To Use:

  • Before first use, wash diapers once.
  • Snap diaper rise to proper size setting.
  • Fasten cover to baby over a flat, pre-fold or fitted diaper.
Wash & Care Instructions

The number one thing to remember when caring for your diapers is they are just another load! There is no magical solution that you should need and no crazy tricks.

Washing Instructions

  • 1 Cold rinse
  • 2 Hot wash: add the recommended amount of detergent for the appropriate load size.
  • 3 Cool rinse
  • 4 Tumble dry low or lay flat to dry in indirect sunlight.

Detergent Recommendations

Click here for Kanga Care's list of recommended detergents that have undergone testing and fulfill the necessary requirements for effectively cleaning human waste.

Please do not use laundry additives such as bleach, Oxiclean, Borax or Bac-out to wash your Kanga Care products, learn more about how this can negatively effect your cloth diapers and accessories.

If you have questions about our washing instructions, please ask! We are happy to help!

Kanga Care brand cloth diapers are the ORIGINAL and ONLY cloth diapers uniquely designed with the patented leak protection technology of dual inner gussets. The inside of each diaper is designed with 2 gentle inner gussets, a double barrier that channels each leg. There is no chance of escape for even the messiest of messes! The Lil Joey takes special care with a snap down front for sensitive cord care during those first precious days.

The Lil Joey is the simplest of diaper systems on the market for a newborn baby. The internal soaker is 4 layers of thirsty microfiber that have been permanently sewn into the core of the diaper, no stuffing required. The Lil Joey is waterproof and requires no cover. Kanga Care uses a water resistant polyester TPU which a is solvent-free polyester fabric that has been laminated with a thermoplastic polyurethane using a heat bonding process, not chemicals. This process is low in toxicity and is better for the natural environment then traditional PUL. One of the most important decisions new parents face, just got easier!

  • Before first use, wash diapers once.

Wash & Care Instructions

The number one thing to remember when caring for your diapers is they are just another load! There is no magical solution that you should need and no crazy tricks.

Washing Instructions

  • 1 Cold rinse
  • 2 Hot wash: add the recommended amount of detergent for the appropriate load size.
